shared_elements: upright slab/pillar with carved figural relief on its face
schematic figure(s) shown in profile-ish low relief
carving confined to the flat frontal surface of a tapering upright
justification: Both surfaces are upright tapering monoliths bearing schematic low-relief carving on the front face, but that is essentially the only correspondence: A shows crowded registers of standing human figures making offerings amid dense sign-like text, divided by a horizontal register line, while B shows a single isolated quadruped-like animal with a curved element (possibly a tail or limb) on an otherwise blank shaft. The subject matter (multi-figure human ritual scene with inscription versus one solitary animal) and the compositional logic (register-filled narrative versus single sparse motif) differ almost completely.
